tasks.name: Setup M1 Environment & Scripts
tasks.input_state: Fresh repository without runtime folder or setup scripts.
tasks.expected_output_contract: ScanLate.bat and scripts/setup.bat are created. The setup script can install Python, PyTorch, dependencies, clone the engine, patch share.py, and download models.

tasks.name: Implement M1 ScanLate API (Launcher & Health)
tasks.expected_output_contract: FastAPI server running on port 8745. /status returns engine health, GPU info. mit_process.py starts the engine in OCR-only mode.

tasks.name: Implement M2 Engine Client & LLM Translation
tasks.input_state: M1 API is functional and engine is healthy.
tasks.expected_output_contract: mit_client.py can fetch /get_text. llm/client.py can translate batch. POST /translate and /translate/batch endpoints return valid JSON bubbles.

tasks.name: Implement M3 Chrome Extension Basics (Manifest, Popup, SW)
tasks.expected_output_contract: Manifest V3 is valid. Service worker handles state in chrome.storage.session. Popup UI displays server status and translates.

tasks.name: Implement M3 Chrome Extension Content Script & Renderer
tasks.expected_output_contract: content.js auto-detects manga images, performs color sampling, auto-font sizing, and creates CSS overlays. content.css provides styles.

tasks.name: Implement M4 Cache System
tasks.input_state: Translation pipeline and extension are fully working.
tasks.expected_output_contract: server/cache/manager.py caches JSON responses by composite key. Repeated requests return cached: true.
